import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Total Sales by Product (Top Left)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors[:len(product_sales)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels
for bar, val in zip(bars1, product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group (Top Right)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
bars2 = ax2.bar(age_sales.index, age_sales.values, color=colors[2:2+len(age_sales)], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
# Add value labels
for bar in bars2:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 50, f'${height:,.0f}',
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 3. Payment Method Distribution with Takeaway Split (Bottom Left)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
payment_takeaway = df.groupby(['payment_method', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
payment_takeaway.columns = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
payment_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=[colors[4], colors[6]], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Sales by Payment Method & Order Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
ax3.legend(title='Order Type', loc='upper right')

# 4. Average Transaction by Size and Product (Bottom Right)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
heatmap_data = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='product', columns='size', aggfunc='mean')
heatmap_data = heatmap_data.reindex(columns=size_order)
sns.heatmap(heatmap_data, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='YlOrRd', ax=ax4, 
            cbar_kws={'label': 'Avg Transaction ($)'}, linewidths=0.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Average Transaction Value by Product & Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
